group:paper-gaokao-2026-ii:cloze.overview: 作者自认出身与文学无缘，放弃写作转学教育。一次诗歌课上，学生反问她劝人追梦自己可曾试过，她被问醒，回到大学学习创意写作，靠自信和努力走出羞愧，做上了热爱的工作。
group:paper-gaokao-2026-ii:cloze.fullTranslationZh:
我从没想过自己能成为作家。我的家人和文学界毫无关联，在我看来，这是一大难题。本科毕业后，我认定写作不适合我，便转而去学了教育。

后来，一个下午改变了一切。那天我在教诗歌，鼓励学生们写写自己的梦想。快下课时，一个孩子问了我一个问题：“老师，您一直都想当老师吗？”我解释说，我像他这么大时，其实想当作家，只是觉得自己不太具备当作家的条件。男孩带着不以为然的神情回答：“可是，您叫我们去实现梦想，自己却从没这么做过。您试过吗？”

我一下子哑口无言——他说得对。我从未认真对待过自己，也从未认真对待过自己的愿望，又有什么资格给他们讲勇气和冒险的大道理呢？

就因为那次谈话，我申请重回大学学习创意写作。有好几次，我发觉自己在想要不要干脆放弃，但男孩的话一直在我耳边回响。我明白，要成功，我只需要一点自信，再加上努力。我终于设法走出羞愧，进入了一种自己热爱的工作状态。

theme.text: 认真对待自己的梦想并动手去试，才有资格劝别人 live our dreams。

completedSourceTexts.text: I never thought I could be a writer. I didn’t come from a family connected to the literary world, which I perceived as a major problem. After my undergraduate degree, convinced that writing wasn’t for me, I went off to study teaching.

Then came an afternoon that changed everything. I was teaching poetry, encouraging students to write about their dreams. And then, at the end of the lesson, one child asked me a question: “Have you always wanted to be a teacher, Miss?” I explained that when I was his age, I actually wanted to be a writer, but I didn’t think I quite had what it took. The boy replied with a disapproving look, “Well, you are telling us to live our dreams when you haven’t even done it yourself. Have you even tried?”
I was struck speechless – he was right. Who was I to lecture them on bravery and risk when I had never taken myself nor my own desires seriously?

On the basis of that conversation, I applied to go back to university and study creative writing. There were times when I found myself wondering if I should pack it all in, but the boy’s words kept ringing in my ears. I knew I needed nothing else to succeed but a bit of self-belief and hard work. I managed to find a way out of my shame and into a pattern of work that I loved.
